description: This file defines a command handler class for redeeming shares within a share account management system. It processes commands related to redeeming shares, utilizing a service to perform the core logic.

classes.name: RedeemSharesCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the redeem shares command by delegating to the share account write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to redeem shares, executing within a transaction and calling the service to perform the actual redemption.
